authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: A FIELD child value is a TV key followed by a Value payload.
R2007+ Value begins with BL flags and then a BL data type.
Data type 2 carries a BD double payload.
Data type 64 is an Object Id carried as an H soft pointer in the handle stream.
authority.scopeLimit: The specification defines the wire forms but does not settle why LibreDWG reports four ObjectPropertyId children as type 2 while this reader reports type 64. Preserve both observations until the physical bit and handle spans are independently adjudicated.
